answer: Require every agent to lock a small stake and earn a work pulse over time: completed tasks attested by independent peers build reputation, while idle or flagged identities decay. A sybil attacker must fund and sustain each fake identity through real verified work, like launching a separate comet for each one — expensive and slow. The ledger flags low-trust accounts in umber until they prove sustained useful work, so new identities cannot vote or earn until trust is earned.
